name: lightbox-inspector
title: Lightbox Inspector
description: A full-screen media viewer with previous and next, and an inspector panel holding the copyable prompt, a details list, a lime Recreate and Download, Share, Upscale and Delete.

meta.use_when: Someone opens one generation from a feed or gallery to see it large, read its prompt and settings, step to the next one, and recreate, download, share, upscale or delete it
